title: Bind the macOS accessibility driver to the click adapter
goal: `nerv desktop-click` presses a named control in a real app on the Mac
acceptance: A real driver (macOS Accessibility API through a small helper) replaces the stub; it checks the Accessibility permission and says how to grant it
Fixture-tree tests unchanged; refusals of password fields, permission dialogs and payment buttons still hold
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-18 when the owner approved adding the live binding the owner check needs. Not a measurement. Closed 2026-11-24: the owner check F-093-T04 exercised the live binding on NERV-01.
